randevu.aciklama: Your booking page where clients pick a time that suits you: event types, working hours, team, reminders and calendar subscription.
randevu.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own booking page and your clients' pages: event types, availability, team, embed code, QR, ICS feed and analytics.
randevu.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy; please select and copy manually.

liste.yeniAciklama: The page address is suggested from the title; you can change it later in settings.
liste.hesap: Client account (leave empty for the agency's own page)

liste2.saklama: Visitor details are deleted automatically {{gun}} days after the appointment (GDPR/KVKK).
liste2.iptalNedeni: Reason for cancelling (emailed to the visitor)
liste2.iptalIpucu: The visitor receives a cancellation email and a calendar cancellation (.ics).
liste2.iptalOnay: Are you sure you want to cancel this booking?

konumYer.telefon: Your number (leave empty if you will call)

konumIpucu.jitsi: An unguessable Jitsi Meet room is created for every booking; the link only appears in the confirmation email.
konumIpucu.baglanti: This link is shared in the email and calendar invite after confirmation.
konumIpucu.telefon: If you enter a number the visitor calls you; if left empty the visitor's phone is required and you call them.
konumIpucu.yuz_yuze: The address is shown on the public page and in the calendar invite.

atamaIpucu.kisi: All bookings go to the selected person.
atamaIpucu.sirali: Goes to the available person with the fewest bookings in the last 90 days.
atamaIpucu.ilk_musait: Goes to the first available person in the list (#1 first).

turler.bos: No event types yet. Start with something like "30-minute intro call".
turler.slugIpucu: Generated from the name if left empty.
turler.adimIpucu: Times are offered at this interval (e.g. 30 min: 09:00, 09:30…).
turler.formIpucu: Name and email are always asked. You can add up to 5 custom questions.
turler.silOnay: Delete "{{ad}}"? It can be restored from the trash.

uygunluk.ekipAciklama: Each person has their own working hours. You choose who hosts in each event type.
uygunluk.saatIpucu: Times are in the page's time zone ({{tz}}).
uygunluk.adayYok: Nobody to add. First invite the person under Profile → Account team and grant the "Appointments" permission.
uygunluk.adayIpucu: Only active people with the "Appointments" permission on your account can be added.
uygunluk.adayIpucuYonetici: Admins and staff can be picked from the list; you can also type another email.
uygunluk.istisnaAciklama: Be closed on a specific date or set special hours for that day.
uygunluk.tatilIpucu: Turkish public holiday list (the one in support settings); half days close at 13:00.

ayarlar.slugIpucu: If the address changes, old links and printed QR codes stop working.
ayarlar.karsilamaOrnek: Pick a time that suits you; the meeting link arrives by email.
ayarlar.logoIpucu: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
ayarlar.saatDilimiIpucu: Your working hours are in this zone; visitors see their own time zone.
ayarlar.dilIpucu: Used when the visitor's browser language is not supported.
ayarlar.aramaMotoruIpucu: When off the page is published with "noindex" (default).
ayarlar.hatirlatmaIpucu: Each reminder is sent once; if the booking was made later, past reminders are skipped.
ayarlar.hatirlatmaSiniri: You can pick at most {{sayi}} reminders.
ayarlar.iptalSiniriIpucu: After this point the visitor can no longer change the booking via the link.
ayarlar.saklamaIpucu: Name, email, phone and answers are deleted this many days after the appointment (GDPR/KVKK).
ayarlar.silAciklama: Cannot be deleted while there are upcoming bookings. A deleted page can be restored from the trash.

paylas.gommeAciklama: Paste the code into your site's HTML: the calendar appears inline or in a pop-up opened by a button.
paylas.gommeIpucu: The script loads from {{site}} and does not slow your site down (about 2 kB).
paylas.qrAlt: QR code of the booking page
paylas.qrIpucu: Download it for business cards, flyers or table cards.
paylas.beslemeAciklama: Add this secret address to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar as a subscription; your bookings appear in your calendar.
paylas.yenileOnay: The old address stops working immediately. Continue?
paylas.google: Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL → paste the address.
paylas.apple: Apple Calendar: File → New Calendar Subscription → paste the address.
paylas.gizli: The address is a password: don't share it. If it leaked, press "Renew address".

analiz.ipucu: Bots are not counted; IP addresses are not stored (daily salted hash).

hata.genel: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
hata.zorunlu: Please fill in the required field.
hata.slug_gecersiz: The address may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3–50).
hata.slug_dolu: This address is already used by another page.
hata.aralik_gecersiz: Invalid time interval (at least 15 min, at most 4 intervals).
hata.aralik_cakisiyor: Intervals on the same day overlap.
hata.soru_sayisi: You can add at most {{en_cok}} questions.
hata.baglanti_gecersiz: The meeting link must start with https://.
hata.grup_tek_kisi: Group types (capacity above 1) need a single host and "One host" assignment.
hata.sayfa_var: This account already has a booking page.
hata.tur_siniri: You have reached the event type limit ({{sinir}}).
hata.kisi_aday_degil: This person is not an active member of your account with the "Appointments" permission.
hata.kisi_siniri: A team can have at most {{sinir}} people.
hata.kisi_var: This person is already on the team.
hata.son_kisi: At least one person must remain on the page.
hata.yaklasan_randevu_var: There are {{sayi}} upcoming bookings; cancel them first.
hata.gecmis_randevu: A past booking cannot be cancelled.
hata.henuz_baslamadi: Attendance can be marked after the appointment starts.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests; please wait a moment.
hata.gorsel_buyuk: The image can be at most {{en_cok_mb}} MB.
hata.gorsel_gecersiz: The image could not be read.
hata.gorsel_boyutu: The image is too small or too large.
hata.depo_hatasi: The file could not be saved.
hata.modul_kapali: The appointments module is not enabled on your account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You don't have permission for this section.
